projects.name: Quadruped Robot
projects.description: A quadruped legged robot platform using servo actuation, IMU feedback, and Jetson-based high-level control.
projects.details: Designed as a robotics research platform combining embedded control, sensor feedback, and high-level AI/ROS-based planning. The system uses STM32-level control for low-level motor behavior and Jetson-based computation for higher-level processing. The goal is to create a modular legged robotics platform that can later support autonomous navigation, stabilization, and research testing.

projects.name: Garbage Segmentation System
projects.description: Computer vision system for detecting and classifying waste objects for automated sorting.
projects.details: A vision-based waste classification and segmentation system intended for smart garbage sorting. The system focuses on identifying different types of waste and supporting automated disposal decisions.
